doc.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Favorite recordings of his own
summary: He likes his own quartet albums and Tinsel with Maynard's band.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Could you pick out of the things you’ve made, your recollection of a personal favorite solo or a recording that you really are glad you did?
Of my own or with a band?

Well I wrote a couple of things out with the quartet that I like. One of them is on VSOP it’s just called “The Lanny Morgan Quartet,” and the other one is after that and it’s on Contemporary and it’s called “Pacific Standard.” I like those two, and some of those things with the big band. I like the thing we did called “Tinsel” with Maynard’s band. That was Willie’s favorite thing that he ever wrote I think. And it’s a ballad, I think I just played a chorus or two of this kind of altered blues thing, but I just kind of liked the way that came together.
